# Jismy Thomas

> Digital marketer based in Kottayam / Kochi, Kerala, India. Works across SEO, WordPress and WooCommerce builds, Google Ads and Meta Ads, organic social growth and short-form video content, handling concept, shoot, edit and ad management herself. Open to full-time roles in Kerala or Goa and to freelance projects anywhere.

The whole portfolio is a single page at https://jismy.in/. Current figures (reel views, campaign results, audience data) are on that page, each with the date it was measured.

## Services

- Search engine optimization: keyword research, on-page structure, metadata and content planning for WordPress sites
- Paid campaigns: Google Ads and Meta Ads setup and monitoring, covering targeting, creative and budget
- Website builds: responsive WordPress and WooCommerce sites
- Organic social growth: content strategy, calendars and short-form video
- Content production: concept, script, shoot and edit, with no separate production team
- Analytics and reporting: Google Analytics, ad dashboards and platform insights

## Work

- [Portfolio](https://jismy.in/): case studies (MI BY JISMY storefront, live Google and Meta campaigns, organic Instagram channel growth) and client campaigns
- [MI BY JISMY](https://mibyjismy.in): clothing storefront she built in WordPress and WooCommerce
- Brand campaigns: Libas, Hay Clothing, Almarah by Pulimoottil, IHA Designs, Twin Birds
